messages.content: I made $85,000 last year. What would my tax be?

function.name: calculate_tax
function.description: Determines the amount of tax owed for a given income. It takes into account various deductions and tax credits. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

income.description: The total income of the individual for the year in dollars. This is a float type value.

filing_status.description: The tax filing status of the individual.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions the individual is claiming in dollars. This is a float type value.

tax_credits.description: The total amount of tax credits the individual is claiming in dollars. This is a float type value.

state.description: The state in which the individual resides, used for determining state-specific taxes.

message.content:
Sure thing! To give you an accurate estimate I’ll just need a few extra bits:

| Question | Why it matters |
|----------|----------------|
| **Filing Status** – single, married filing jointly/separately, head‑of‑household, etc. | Different brackets & standard deductions apply. |
| **Deductions** – Do you plan on taking the standard deduction ($13,850 for single / $27,700 for MFJ in 2025) or have itemizable expenses (mortgage interest, charitable gifts, medical costs, etc.)? | Deductions reduce taxable income. |
| **Tax Credits** – Any education credits, child tax credit, energy‑efficiency credits, etc.? | Credits directly lower your tax bill. |
| **State of Residence** – Which state did you live in during the year? | Some states levy their own income tax with different rates/brackets. |

If you’re okay with a rough federal-only estimate using the standard deduction and assuming “single” status, let me know and I’ll run the numbers right away. Otherwise, feel free to fill out those details so I can provide a precise calculation.
message.reasoning:
We need to ask clarifying questions about filing status, deductions, etc., or we can assume defaults (single, no deductions/credits). But user didn't specify. We should respond asking for more details.
